name: Rot Hide Clues

meta.next: Rot Hide Ichor (quest), The Engraved Ring

summary: At Lordamere Lake, Rot Hide Clues come to light with an engraved ring on a recently deceased woman's hand. When you report the grim find to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher, he sees that Rot Hide gnolls are taking bodies from Tirisfal's mass graves and carrying them to Fenris Isle.

sections.title: A Gruesome Cargo
sections.body: Forsaken scouts find a ferry laden with corpses on the shore of Lordamere Lake. Among the dead is the unwrapped, plague-marked hand of a recently slain woman. A plain band on it bears the words “For Deliah.” The ferry points to an organized effort to move the dead, not scavengers feeding at random.

sections.title: Raiders of the Graves
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec fits the clues together when Deliah's ring reaches him at the Sepulcher. He concludes that a body so recently buried came from the mass graves across the border in Tirisfal Glades. Rot Hide gnolls in Silverpine are methodically digging up human corpses and shipping them across the water to Fenris Isle. No one knows why.

faq.q: What is the Corpse Laden Boat?
faq.answer: It is an old ferry moored along the shore of Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest. Rot Hide gnolls use it to carry exhumed human corpses across the water to their stronghold on Fenris Isle.
Deliah was a human plague victim recently buried in the mass graves of Tirisfal Glades. Rot Hide gnolls stole her body, leaving her engraved ring behind as a clue.

faq.q: Why are gnolls gathering dead bodies?
faq.answer: The Rot Hides are undead gnolls who serve the Scourge. They rob Tirisfal's mass graves and ship the corpses to the Scourge stronghold on Fenris Isle instead of eating them.

High Executor Hadrec commands the Forsaken forces stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He oversees defenses against regional threats, including feral Rot Hide gnolls, Dalaran wizards, and the Worgen.

faq.q: Where did the corpses on the boat come from?
faq.answer: Hadrec concludes that the bodies were dug up from the mass graves in nearby Tirisfal Glades. Victims of the Scourge and plague were hastily buried there.

faq.q: What happens after reporting this clue to Hadrec?
faq.answer: Hadrec sends agents to confront the Rot Hide threat on Fenris Isle and retrieve samples of the putrid ichor the gnolls are refining. His actions also prompt an investigation into Deliah's identity and the return of her ring.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the desecration of Tirisfal's mass graves strikes close to home. Their fallen kin and unrisen brethren are being carried away as raw material for gnoll alchemical horrors.
Hadrec coordinates Horde operations from the Sepulcher to secure Silverpine against growing monster encampments. The Rot Hide pack occupies Fenris Isle.
